annotator2: descriptive sensitivity on actual observed subset; no forced consensus

donor.assignment: sort original TRAIN group hashes, seeded permutation then one cyclic successor; at least2 groups
donor.forbidden: shuffling only the three siblings within one question
donor.positions: keep generator positions in original release order; donor labels from matching generator
donor.report: donor map and actual changed-label numerator/denominator/fraction; zero change is retained as degenerate

embedding.empty: zero vector of runtime hidden width; no synthetic token; flag empty
embedding.model: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF Q4_K_M; actual frozen llama.cpp runtime
embedding.normalization: independent question and answer L2, then concatenate in that order
embedding.padding: exclude padding from mean; all-padding becomes flagged zero vector
embedding.runtime_binding: before extraction seal GGUF SHA256, embedded tokenizer metadata and runtime binary/build SHA256; missing or unsupported hidden states block
embedding.special_tokens: add_bos=False; no chat template, EOS, separator or dataset tags

fit.coefficient_hashes: hash actual before/after trained coefficients; require real changes; no metadata-only changes
fit.convergence: all six arms require verified finite objective and gradient bound; otherwise disqualify
fit.loss: mean proper binary logloss +0.5*0.01*sum(nonintercept coefficient squares)
fit.optimizer: L-BFGS-B from zeros; maxiter2000, gtol1e-7, ftol1e-12
fit.training: TRAIN A1 only; no CAL/TEST targets or A2 used in fitting

length_features: log1p(full embedded-tokenizer question count), log1p(full answer count); TRAIN-only center/std
partition: original V726 fit=TRAIN, tune=CAL, test=TEST; no repartition or exclusions for exposure

projection.center_scale: TRAIN-only population mean/std (ddof=0); constants use scale1
projection.scaling: TRAIN-only projected coordinate min/max to[-1,1]; constants0; future clip[-1,1]

references: author ref_str and annotations are evaluator/context records only

spline.columns: intercept +27 linear +189 fixed basis; identical donor architecture

strata: question-level A2 unobserved, observed with any disagreement, observed with no disagreement; retain actual A2 support and missingness

uncertainty.ranking: ascending p(error), tie original item order, accept floor(N/2) occurrences per draw
uncertainty.retain: all arm predictions, numerators, denominators, draw counts and paired contrasts against every control
uncertainty.scope: conditional descriptive exposed-development intervals; no confirmatory significance, independent generalization or training-variability coverage
uncertainty.unit: original TEST qid with all siblings
uncertainty.zero_denominator: null metric; report undefined draws and actual support
